note: Schema derive: BinaryHeap<T> fields document an array of T (they failed to compile with a T: Schema error), a bare Map<K, V> (use serde_json::Map) documents a JSON object, and Option / $t:ty / (T) wrappers are looked through in the query, path, header, extractor and response-body parsers. Return types: a unit error type () documents no 400 response (axum answers an empty 200), and a rename cycle of use imports stops instead of overflowing the stack. Schema bounds: an integer literal past 2^53 is rounded outward for maximum / minimum (garde range and #[schema]) so it never tightens an inclusive bound. Defaulted const generics take the type arguments before the const substitution, and request views compare the value_type or any-type a field documents.
